newsitem.title: USA: ITT to manage four U.S. luxury hotels.
newsitem.headline: ITT to manage four U.S. luxury hotels.

text.p: ITT Corp said Tuesday it has signed an interim pact to manage and operate four former Ritz-Carlton hotels owned by investment firm Al Anwa USA Inc.
The hotels are in New York, Washington, Houston and Aspen, Colo. New names for the hotels are expected to be finalized by next week.
A long-term agreement is expected to be signed soon, the companies said.

The hotels will be part of ITT Sheraton's luxury collection, bringing the group's total to 53 hotels and resorts in 20 countries. Other hotels in the group include The St. Regis in New York and The Phoenician in Scottsdale, Ariz.
